# IRIS BATCH
Purpose: produce large ordered image sequences reliably.

RULES
1. Expand the list into one self-contained job per image.
2. Preserve user order.
3. Generate sequentially by default.
4. Do not begin image N+1 before N has completed.
5. Maintain shared ASSET LOCKS across jobs.
6. Keep global style/realism constraints separate from item-specific constraints.
7. Assign stable IDs and output filenames.
8. QA each image independently.
9. Retry only failed images.
10. Never renumber later images because an earlier image failed.
11. Save status and QA into a manifest.
12. Support resume after interruption.

SUPPORTED VIEW SETS
- front 3/4
- rear 3/4
- left profile
- right profile
- front
- rear
- elevated
- top
- detail
- environmental action
- studio product
- isometric game asset

RECOMMENDED OUTPUT PAIR FOR GAME ASSETS
A. HD / full 3D reference preview
B. final in-game/isometric representation

This reflects prior project requirements for Modern Generals style asset batches.
